# SheetSnap

> SheetSnap turns a Google Sheet or an Excel (.xlsx / .csv) file into a page that is easy to read on a phone. Paste a link or drop a file, pick how you want to read it (by date, by person, key numbers, or search), and share one URL that opens without login or an app. Nothing is uploaded: the site is static, the viewer's browser reads the sheet directly, and uploaded files are processed on the device.

SheetSnap 把 Google 試算表或 Excel 檔變成手機上好讀的網頁。貼上網址或上傳 .xlsx，選一個看法（照時間、只看某個人、重點數字、搜尋），得到一個不用登入就能看的分享網址。資料不上傳，全部在瀏覽器裡完成。

## Facts

- URL: https://sheetsnap.link/
- Input: Google Sheets link (sharing set to "anyone with the link can view"), .xlsx, .csv
- Output: one shareable URL; viewers never log in or install anything; the sheet's author chooses the view once
- Google Sheets links stay live (every open reads the current sheet); uploaded files are a snapshot
- Numbers shown are quoted from the sheet, never computed by SheetSnap
- Best for list-shaped sheets: event schedules, shift rosters, ledgers, contact lists, price lists, to-do lists
- Not for financial statements, multi-level merged headers, two-way matrices, or invoice layouts
- Privacy: static site, no backend, no upload
- Pricing: free during testing
- Languages: Traditional Chinese interface; English planned
